description: HTTP, HTTPS and WebSocket debugging proxy
notes: Librium keeps its CA certificate and its SQLite history in %LOCALAPPDATA%\Librium and its filter sessions, logs and the Chrome proxy profile in %APPDATA%\librium-desktop, outside the Scoop app directory, so they survive updates and are left behind by 'scoop uninstall librium'. Delete both folders by hand for a clean slate.
Set LIBRIUM_DATA_DIR to move that data anywhere else, for example onto the same portable drive as Scoop itself.
The UI listens on http://127.0.0.1:3000 and the proxy on 127.0.0.1:8080; LIBRIUM_UI_PORT and LIBRIUM_PROXY_PORT change both.
For HTTPS, install the generated CA from %LOCALAPPDATA%\Librium\ca.crt into 'Trusted Root Certification Authorities'.
